description: This horizontal stacked bar chart, titled "QA-2", illustrates the evaluation outcomes for two models. The vertical category axis lists the models from top to bottom: "EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0" and "RedWhale (our)", without an explicit axis label. The horizontal value axis lacks an explicit line, label, scale, tick marks, or units, instead relying on numerical annotations within the bar segments to convey values. Each model's performance is represented by a single horizontal bar stacked with three color-coded segments, arranged from left to right based on the legend at the bottom: "Correct" in dark purple, "Partially Correct" in medium blue, and "Incorrect" in light blue. For "EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0", the dark purple "Correct" segment is annotated with 92.9, the medium blue "Partially Correct" segment has its numerical value obscured by a solid grey rectangle, and the light blue "Incorrect" segment is labeled 4.3. For "RedWhale (our)", the "Correct" segment is the largest at 95.7, the "Partially Correct" segment is the shortest at 1.4, and the "Incorrect" segment is 2.9. The categories are not sorted by any explicit numerical value. The data labels are written directly inside the segments, using white text for the darker segments and black text for the lightest segment, with the grey obscuring box in the top bar acting as a notable visual alteration.
